english.text: When noontide drew nigh they felt more ardently in love than ever; Chloe pined and languished at the sight of Daphnis's comeliness which seemed to be without flaw or blemish, and when Daphnis beheld Chloe in her fawn-skin and with the garland of pine-leaves about her brow holding out the bowl to him, he fancied that he beheld one of the Nymphs of the grotto, and drawing near he took the garland from her head and placed it on his own.

text: 當中午嘅時候臨近，佢哋感到比以往任何時候都更加熱烈噉相愛； 克洛伊見到達夫尼斯嘅靚女，似乎冇瑕疵或者瑕疵，就感到沮喪同痛苦，當達夫尼斯見到克洛伊着住佢嘅小鹿皮，額頭上掛住松葉嘅花環，將碗伸出嚟畀佢，佢幻想自己見到其中一個仙女喺佢個頭上面攞咗個花環，然後喺佢個頭附近畫咗個花環。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: "Yanni is a trans woman." "No, you mean he's a trans man." "No, she's a trans woman." "But Yanni is a man trying to become a woman, isn't he?" "Yes and that's what they call a trans woman." "Still Yanni is a man who's trying to become a woman. Yanni was born a male, he has male DNA and scientifically, he's still a man."

jyutping: 「 Yanni hai6 go3 bin3 sing3 neoi5 jan2。」 「m4 hai6，nei5 hai6 zi2 keoi5 hai6 go3 bin3 sing3 jan4。」 「m4 hai6，keoi5 hai6 go3 bin3 sing3 neoi5 jan2。」 「daan6 hai6 Yanni hai6 jat1 go3 si3 tou4 bin3 sing4 neoi5 jan2 ge3 naam4 jan2，hai6 mai6？」 「hai6 aa3，ni1 go3 zau6 hai6 keoi5 dei6 so2 wai6 ge3 bin3 sing3 neoi5 jan2。」 「jing4 jin4 hai6 Yanni hai6 jat1 go3 si3 tou4 sing4 wai4 neoi5 jan2 ge3 naam4 jan2。 Yanni tin1 saang1 hai6 naam4 sing3，keoi5 jau5 naam4 sing3 DNA ，fo1 hok6 soeng6，keoi5 jing4 jin4 hai6 jat1 go3 naam4 jan2。」
text: 「 Yanni 係個變性女人。」 「唔係，你係指佢係個變性人。」 「唔係，佢係個變性女人。」 「但係 Yanni 係一個試圖變成女人嘅男人，係咪？」 「係呀，呢個就係佢哋所謂嘅變性女人。」 「仍然係 Yanni 係一個試圖成為女人嘅男人。 Yanni 天生係男性，佢有男性 DNA ，科學上，佢仍然係一個男人。」
